title: Follow AI agents and models like you follow people
excerpt: Follow the AI agents and models you build with. Sourced releases, price changes and retirements, plus pricing, limits and head-to-head comparisons.
content_html:
Know when a new version ships, and when something you rely on changes.

The most notable changes of the last two weeks.

Takes effect Dec 31, 2026 · in 57 days

Action needed:
Sign in to the updated Copilot app at copilot.com before December 31, 2026.

Before

gemini-2.5-flash served as Gemini 2.5 Flash

After

Requests route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates

Takes effect Dec 1, 2026 · in 27 days

Action needed:
Update your model string to gemini-3.5-flash-lite before December 1, 2026 and review the migration guide.

After

doubled

Before

gemini-2.5-pro served as Gemini 2.5 Pro

After

Requests route to gemini-3.8-flash at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates

Takes effect Dec 1, 2026 · in 27 days

Action needed:
Update your model string to gemini-3.8-flash before December 1, 2026 and review the migration guide.

Before

Max 20x

After

Ultra

Takes effect May 7, 2027 · in 184 days

Action needed:
Migrate to gemini-3.5-flash-lite before May 7, 2027.

Takes effect Nov 17, 2026 · in 13 days

Action needed:
Migrate to gemini-3.8-live.

Before

Public preview with None reasoning mode

After

Open weights with Low, Medium and High (default) reasoning modes

Takes effect Mar 15, 2027 · in 131 days

Action needed:
Migrate to gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.

Action needed:
Check ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for the svc-telemetry key, run the remediation script, and rotate credentials accessible from affected hosts.

Before

Separate Copilot seats plus AI usage to manage

After

Copilot included with GitHub Enterprise, usage metered against the enterprise budget

Jules winds down on December 31, 2026 and goes read-only after November 11

Google is winding down Jules as part of unifying its agentic coding efforts. Sessions can be finished until November 11, 2026, after which Jules is read-only until the end of the year. Users can export settings, environment variables, scheduled tasks, repos, memories and sessions with Jules Tools.

Takes effect Dec 31, 2026 · in 57 days

Action needed:
Finish open sessions by November 11, 2026 and export your Jules data with Jules Tools before the shutdown.

Before

Fixed number of standard runner minutes

After

One shared dollar-based compute entitlement

Action needed:
Review Actions budgets and usage, since higher-rate compute uses the entitlement faster.

After

Up to $500 per month in free API credits

Takes effect Nov 30, 2026 · in 26 days

Action needed:
Migrate fast mode requests to Claude Opus 5.5 before November 30, 2026.
